source: Wrangler D1 Query Insights, read-only November26 2026; rolling windows, sampled estimates, not exact UTC daily totals

sevenDaysAccount.query: SELECT * FROM items WHERE user_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id
UPDATE items SET axis_missing = 1, updated_at = ?1 WHERE user_id = ?2 AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?3))
SELECT id, axis_uid, title, due_date, class_id, notes, completed, deleted_at, axis_missing FROM items WHERE user_id = ? AND axis_uid IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO items (user_id, id, title, due_date, class_id, notes, type, due_time, source, axis_uid, axis_missing, updated_at) SELECT ?1, json_extract(value, '$.id'), json_extract(value, '$.title'), json_extract(value, '$.due_date'), json_extract(value, '$.class_id'), json_extract(value, '$.notes'), json_extract(value, '$.type'), json_extract(value, '$.due_time'), json_extract(value, '$.source'), json_extract(value, '$.axis_uid'), json_extract(value, '$.axis_missing'), ?3 FROM json_each(?2) WHERE true ON CONFLICT (user_id, axis_uid) DO NOTHING

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exact_groups, COALESCE(SUM(n-1),0) AS exact_extra_rows, MAX(n) AS most_copies FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM items WHERE source='axis' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY user_id,class_id,title,type,due_date,due_time,notes HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeated_groups, COALESCE(SUM(n-1),0) AS extra_rows, MAX(n) AS most_copies FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM items WHERE source='axis' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY user_id, class_id, title, due_date, due_time HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.display_name, u.password_hash FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = ? AND s.expires_at > ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS axis_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT axis_uid) AS unique_uids, SUM(axis_missing) AS missing_rows FROM items WHERE source='axis'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS linked_descriptions FROM items WHERE source='axis' AND notes LIKE '%https://%'
DELETE FROM task_alarms WHERE fire_at<?
SELECT * FROM classes WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at, id

select "users"."id", "users"."email", "users"."phone_number", "users"."display_name", "users"."avatar_url" from "sessions" inner join "users" on "sessions"."user_id" = "users"."id" where ("sessions"."token_hash" = ? and "sessions"."expires_at" > ?) limit ?

update "learning_progress" set "activity_type" = ?, "schema_version" = ?, "payload" = ?, "revision" = "learning_progress"."revision" + 1, "deleted" = ?, "updated_at" = ? where ("learning_progress"."user_id" = ? and "learning_progress"."activity_id" = ? and "learning_progress"."activity_type" = ? and "learning_progress"."revision" = ? and "learning_progress"."generation" = ?) returning "user_id", "activity_id", "activity_type", "schema_version", "payload", "revision", "generation", "deleted", "updated_at"
ALTER TABLE planner_imports ADD COLUMN goals_added INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (goals_added >= 0)
UPDATE items SET completed = ?1, completed_at = CASE WHEN ?1 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(completed_at, ?2) END, updated_at = ?2 WHERE id = ?3 AND user_id = ?4 AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING *

insert into "users" ("id", "email", "phone_number", "display_name", "avatar_url", "created_at", "updated_at") values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) on conflict ("users"."id") do update set "email" = ?, "phone_number" = ?, "display_name" = ?, "avatar_url" = ?, "updated_at" = ?
